caseName: Colburn v. Cockrell, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division
caseNameFull: Colburn v. Cockrell, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division

opinions.text: Petitioner is directed to file a petition for writ of certiorari on or before 3 p.m., Monday, December 9, 2002. A brief in opposition is due on or before 3 p.m., Monday, December 30, 2002. A reply brief, if any, shall be filed within seven days of the filing of the brief in opposition. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
